en: That launcher keeps what cargo says, so that the line about the lock exists to be read whatever the caller asked to see. While the last thing cargo said is that it is blocked on a build directory, the launcher counts; at <t1/> seconds (sixty, unless set; zero never waits) it says how long it waited and which other cargo processes exist, stops that cargo, and runs the same build in the tree's own build directory, after the disk floor has been asked.
